part1Questions: Do you work or are you a student?
What do you like most about your job?
Do you think your job will change in the future?
Would you like to change your career someday?

part2.cueCardTitle: Describe a job you would like to have in the future
bulletPoints: why you would like to do it
and explain how you could get this job

part3Questions: Why do some people change their careers several times in their life?
Do you think salary is the most important factor when choosing a job? Why or why not?
How is the job market changing because of technology?
Should governments help train people for jobs that are in high demand?

part1Questions: What do you like about living there?
Do you enjoy travelling to new places?
What was the last trip you took?

part2.cueCardTitle: Describe a place you visited that you really enjoyed
bulletPoints: and explain why you enjoyed it so much

part3Questions: Why do you think tourism is important for a country's economy?
How has tourism changed in your country over the last twenty years?
What are the disadvantages of a place becoming too popular with tourists?
Do you think people will travel more or less in the future? Why?

part1Questions: Do you use a smartphone every day?
What apps do you use most often?
Has technology made your life easier or more complicated?
What new technology would you like to try?

part2.cueCardTitle: Describe a piece of technology that you find useful
bulletPoints: and explain why it is useful to you

part3Questions: How has technology changed the way people communicate with each other?
Do you think children today spend too much time using technology?
What are the risks of relying too much on technology at work?
How might artificial intelligence change everyday life in the next ten years?
